primitives.name: Analyst Consensus Agreement
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B': 'count of bullish mentions', 'b': 'count of bearish mentions'}
primitives.assumptions: Each mention is independent and binary; no partial agreement modeled.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When B = 0 or b = 0, agreement is undefined or extreme (0% or 100%).

layer2.telemetry: Percentage of bullish over total bullish/bearish mentions.

primitives.name: Play Mention Count
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Methodology & honesty labels - **One "mention"** = one feed document recording an outlet/analyst as bullish, bearish, or neutral on a player/play.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'M': 'total mentions across all feeds', 'n': 'number of distinct feed documents', '\\mathbb{1}': 'indicator function'}
primitives.assumptions: Each feed contributes at most one mention per player; duplicates within a feed are ignored.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When M = 0, no consensus exists; when M > 0, consensus begins to form.

layer2.mapping: Quantifies the frequency of a play's appearance in analyst feeds.
layer2.telemetry: Total number of unique analyst mentions for a given play.

primitives.name: Game Total Consensus
primitives.verbatim_quote: CONSENSUS BOARD — top 20 most-agreed plays Ranked by total mentions across all 18 processed feeds.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'k': 'number of plays considered', 'M_j': 'mentions for play j'}
primitives.assumptions: All plays are ranked by total mentions; higher ranks imply stronger consensus.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When total mentions exceed threshold, game becomes a high-confidence stack.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to the top-k ranking of plays based on aggregated mentions.
layer2.telemetry: Ranking of games by sum of mentions across all analyst feeds.

The 'game_total_consensus' primitive aggregates these into a global ranking system. These operators interact to form a dual structure: one layer for individual player confidence and another for game-level stack formation. Failure modes include data integrity issues from conflicting feeds, which are flagged but not resolved, and over-reliance on recent mentions without temporal context. The model assumes independence of mentions and binary sentiment classification, limiting its ability to capture nuanced shifts in opinion.
